topic: Fearing a non-compete vs getting it reviewed for enforceability (Otis vs Lena)

scenes.narration: She feared her non-compete, until a lawyer called it worthless paper. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera in a courtroom holding a non-compete document crumbling into worthless scraps, comic burst banner reads WORTHLESS PAPER, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Otis and Lena each signed non-competes at their old jobs.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man otis and woman lena in the courtroom, each holding signed non-compete papers from old jobs, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: A non-compete must be reasonable in time, scope, and geography.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a glowing contract on the courtroom bench labeled REASONABLE IN TIME SCOPE GEOGRAPHY, a gavel beside it, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Otis assumes his non-compete blocks every job in his field.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man otis imagining every job door slammed shut, a giant stamp reads BLOCKED across his field, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He turns down a great offer, fearing a costly lawsuit.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man otis reluctantly refusing a golden job offer letter, fearing a lawsuit gavel shadow, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Lena has an employment lawyer carefully review her non-compete clause.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman lena handing her non-compete to a lawyer at a desk labeled EMPLOYMENT LAWYER REVIEW, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The lawyer finds it far too broad to be enforceable.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, the lawyer stamping the clause TOO BROAD NOT ENFORCEABLE, woman lena relieved, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Lena confidently accepts a better job at a rival company.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman lena confidently shaking hands at a rival company, a banner reads NEW JOB ACCEPTED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: A year later, Otis is stuck, underpaid and deeply frustrated.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man otis stuck at an old desk looking frustrated, a calendar showing a full year passed, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The clause he feared was never enforceable in his state.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a torn non-compete labeled NEVER ENFORCEABLE floating over man otis's head, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Lena thrives in her new role, facing no lawsuit at all.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman lena thriving at her new desk, no lawsuit in sight, a banner reads NO LAWSUIT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Get a non-compete reviewed; overly broad clauses often can't be enforced. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel in the courtroom, a clipboard reads GET NON-COMPETES REVIEWED, comic burst banner reads DISMISSED, kids comic book illustration
